summary: Security-fix verification round (SEC-001/002/003) for Combo Milan. Backend: 25/25 pytest passed after ONE real fix I applied. SEC-001 verified: POST /api/groups and /api/models return 403 with no header, wrong passcode, and empty passcode; 200 with X-Admin-Passcode: 4321; self-marking status='verified' without auth is rejected; GETs, /confirm and /submissions remain public and working. SEC-003 INITIALLY FAILED: 70 rapid confirms all returned 200 — RCA: rate limiter keyed on request.client.host, which behind the K8s ingress is the ingress controller pod IP (logs showed TWO source IPs 10.79.142.5 / 10.79.142.2), sharding the per-IP bucket and multiplying the effective limit by proxy count. Fixed by preferring X-Forwarded-For first hop in rate_limit() (server.py); re-test now returns 429 after 60 req/min. SEC-002 verified: esc() prefixes apostrophe for =,+,-,@,TAB,CR leading cells and double-escapes quotes (logic replicated and unit-checked; CSV export still downloads combo-milan.csv from UI). Frontend E2E passed: Add data -> keypad 4321 -> Add Data screen (passcode stored in storage and sent as header) -> created group 'TEST_UISEC Model Alpha/Beta' (Battery/Redmi-Poco) -> 'Saved successfully' toast -> group appears on Home search; cleared passcode -> direct /add-data save shows server message 'Invalid admin passcode' in toast. CORS allow_credentials=False confirmed in code.

minor.issue: FIXED BY TESTING AGENT: rate_limit() used request.client.host which is the ingress controller IP behind K8s (multiple ingress pods -> multiple independent 60/min buckets -> limit effectively 120+/min and keyed on proxy, not client). Now prefers X-Forwarded-For first hop. Note: X-Forwarded-For is spoofable by direct clients if backend is ever exposed without the ingress — acceptable for this preview topology but worth a comment.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py admin auth is correct: verify_admin runs before rate_limit in dependency order, so unauthenticated 403s don't consume rate-limit budget. Passcode compared with strip(); 403 detail 'Invalid admin passcode' surfaces verbatim in the app toast — good UX.
ADMIN_PASSCODE falls back to hardcoded '4321' if env missing (server.py:24) — a fail-open default; recommend os.environ['ADMIN_PASSCODE'] without default so misconfiguration fails closed.

src/api.ts correctly awaits getAdminPasscode() and sends X-Admin-Passcode only on useCreateGroup/useCreateModel; confirm/submissions stay header-less as designed. Web secure storage falls back to AsyncStorage/localStorage (index.web.ts) — passcode is plaintext in localStorage on web, acceptable for a 4-digit gate but noted.
esc() in index.tsx covers =,+,-,@,TAB,CR leading chars and CSV quote-escaping; matches OWASP CSV injection guidance.

rca_of_issue: SEC-003 rate limiting appeared broken (70 rapid confirms -> all 200). Reproduction: curl loop of 70 POSTs to /api/groups/{id}/confirm via public URL. RCA: backend access logs showed requests arriving from TWO different ingress controller pod IPs (10.79.142.5, 10.79.142.2); rate_limit() keyed on request.client.host (the proxy), so each ingress node had its own 60/min bucket and the real client was never identified — effective limit >= 120/min and shared across ALL app users per ingress node. Mitigation applied: rate_limit() now prefers the first X-Forwarded-For hop (set by the ingress), falling back to client.host. Post-fix: 429 returned after 60 requests/min from one client IP; normal confirm flow unaffected (25/25 tests pass).
